Verification performed when vendoring (repeat when bumping the version):

  curl -sSLO https://registry.npmjs.org/mermaid/-/mermaid-11.17.2.tgz
  openssl dgst -sha512 -binary mermaid-11.17.2.tgz | openssl base64 -A
  tar -xzf mermaid-11.17.2.tgz package/dist/mermaid.min.js package/LICENSE
  sha256sum package/dist/mermaid.min.js
  cmp package/dist/mermaid.min.js docs/assets/vendor/mermaid-11.17.2.min.js
  cmp package/LICENSE docs/assets/vendor/mermaid-11.17.2.LICENSE.txt

Why vendored: mkdocs.yml previously loaded a floating
`https://unpkg.com/mermaid@11/...` URL with no integrity attribute, so any
tampered 11.x release would run arbitrary JavaScript on the project's docs
domain. A fixed local file means the site ships exactly the reviewed bytes and
makes no third-party script request at all. Bump the version and this file in
the same commit, and delete the old file.
